## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Croatian Field Boundaries](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/hr) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Republic of Croatia

Provides 1346655 official field boundaries from Republic of Croatia.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from 
Agencija za plaćanja u poljoprivredi, ribarstvu i ruralnom razvoju objavila.

Data published by Republic of Croatia, in the ARKOD system. ARKOD is a record of the use of agricultural
land in the territory of the Republic of Croatia, which is maintained in digital graphic form by the Agency for Payments.

ARKOD plots represent uninterrupted areas of agricultural land cultivated by one farmer, classified according to
the type of use of agricultural land from gievn Annex I of the Ordinance on records of use of agricultural land.

Process for registration of agricultural land - vectorization of ARKOD polygons is carried out by the method of
photointerpretation of agricultural land on DOF bases on a scale of 1:5000 in branches of the Agency for Payments,
statements of farmers on the use of agricultural land with proof of ownership or possession.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Agencija za plaćanja u poljoprivredi, ribarstvu i ruralnom razvoju objavila](https://www.apprrr.hr/prostorni-podaci-servisi/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** Not stated . Data is downloadable.
- **Projection:** EPSG:9122

---

## Columns

| Property     | **Data Type** | Description          |
|--------------|---------------|----------------------|
| id           | string        |                      |
| crop_code    | int           | Crop code            |
| crop_name    | string        | Crop name (Croatian) |
| crop_name_en | string        | Crop name (English)  |
| area         | Real          | Area                 |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-14 from https://www.apprrr.hr/wp-content/uploads/nipp/land_parcels.gpkg .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0
